newsitem.title: CHINA: China chemical sector H1 net plunges 78 pct.
newsitem.headline: China chemical sector H1 net plunges 78 pct.

text.p: China's chemical industry posted after-tax profits of 602 million yuan ($72.5 million) for the first half of 1997, down 78 percent from the year-ago period, official media said on Tuesday.
Sales of the chemical sector reached 132.3 billion yuan in the first six months, up three percent year -on-year, the China Chemical Industry News said.
Costs hit 108.9 billion yuan in the period, a rise of five percent from the year-ago period, the newspaper quoted the Ministry of Chemical Industry as saying.
Funds tied up in chemical stockpiles amounted to 30.185 billion yuan in the first half, up 34 percent from a year ago, it said.
Of China's 4,401 chemical firms, 2,020 reported losses in the first half, including 1,352 state-owned firms with combined losses of 2.853 billion yuan, the newspaper added.
The output value of China's chemical industry reached 38.7 billion yuan in the first half, up six percent year-on-year, it said, without giving further details.
